{{Quote|A good Jedi doesn't ''need'' possessions anyway.''"<br />"''You have ''your'' ship!''"<br />"''Yeah, but I'm not a very good Jedi, am I?|[[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Republic: Dreadnaughts of Rendili">''[[Star Wars: Republic: Dreadnaughts of Rendili]]''</ref>}}
The '''''Skorp-Ion''''' was the personal ship of [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] during his time as a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] double-agent. [[Tol Skorr]], jealous of Vos, always desired it. Following the [[Siege of Saleucami/Legends|Siege of Saleucami]], [[Khaleen Hentz/Legends|Khaleen Hentz]] flew it to [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] to await the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
